methodology.purpose: Descriptive audit of whether deterministic pre-entry setup information separates the four already-defined loss-path archetypes A/B/C/D.
methodology.archetypeBasis: Only losing baseline trades are labeled after the fact by pre-exit MFE: A <0.5R, B 0.5R-<1R, C 1R-<2R, D >=2R.
methodology.featureGuard: All predictor features use only candles available at or before canonical entry. Post-entry MFE is used only as the loss-archetype label and never as a predictor.
methodology.compression: Within the complete loss population, each feature is percentile-ranked and each family score is the unweighted mean of member ranks.
methodology.validation: Family archetype means, median ranks, standardized deltas and one-vs-rest AUC are reported descriptively; DEV/VAL, direction and session counts test temporal/context stability.
